verdict.line: You lose if you auto-attack into an up Ground Slam and eat the attack-speed shred; you win if you poke with Q while his E is down and chain the 3-stack stun into a Devour before he hits level 6.

brief.thesis: Malphite's Ground Slam (E) and Granite Shield exist specifically to punish auto-attack-reliant champions, which is exactly how Tahm Kench's passive deals damage — but his engage tools are slow and telegraphed compared to Tahm's Q stun chain and E shield timing. The 53.5% win rate over 370 games reflects that Tahm out-scales Malphite's trade pattern once he learns to time around the E cooldown instead of fighting through it.

theirWindow.what: Ground Slam shreds your attack speed for a short duration, which guts the auto-attack damage your passive depends on. Back off and throw Q instead of trading autos into it.

yourWindow.what: Step in and auto-attack freely — this is the window OP.GG's own data flags, since every attack both deals passive bonus damage and builds An Acquired Taste toward a stun.

start.why: The 74.7% pick rate and 51.2% win rate reflect how well its harass-sustain passive absorbs Malphite's early auto and Seismic Shard trades.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the Seismic Shard slow short and reduces how long Unstoppable Force's knockup locks you down once he hits 6.

core.why: Stacking health directly scales your passive's bonus magic damage on autos and raises Devour's damage ceiling.

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain and bonus health from every proc compounds with Heartsteel stacking and directly scales your passive's attack damage, which is the engine of this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (62.1% pick rate, 53.3% win rate) and matches the aggressive, solo-kill-favoured shape of this lane — Ignite secures the kill once your Q stun lands.

playing.title: Trade only when his E is down
playing.detail: Ground Slam (7s cooldown) reduces attack speed on hit, which is the direct counter to your auto-attack passive. Watch its cooldown and step in only once it's spent.

playing.title: Poke with Q while his E is up
playing.detail: Tongue Lash (7-5s cooldown depending on rank, 900 range) slows and stacks An Acquired Taste without exposing you to the attack-speed shred.

playing.title: Hold Thick Skin's shield for his R
playing.detail: E passively stores damage taken; pop the active shield right before he charges Unstoppable Force at level 6+ to blunt the knockup burst.

playing.title: Stun before you Devour
playing.detail: At 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, Q stuns and consumes them — land that stun, then use Devour (R, 0 cooldown) for a near-guaranteed kill window if he's isolated from minions.

playing.title: Keep hitting him to deny shield regen
playing.detail: Granite Shield recharges if he hasn't been hit recently, so land a Q every cooldown to keep it down ahead of your all-in.

playing.title: Use W to punish poke, not to open
playing.detail: Abyssal Dive (21-17s cooldown) knocks up on landing but telegraphs hard — save it to answer a Seismic Shard poke or escape a bad trade rather than starting the fight with it.

playing.title: Farm safely between trades
playing.detail: Heartsteel's health stacking scales both your passive damage and Devour's magic damage, so there's no need to force early fights — scaling wins this on its own.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Malphite’s (E) poses a problem to Tahm Kench as he relies heavily on basic attacks. Use [Q] when his (E) is on cooldown to kill him. After reaching level 6, be ready to use [E] before he uses (R) when fighting him.
